title: Exact learner resource bounds
statement: For every natural number $n$, every Boolean function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and every natural number $k$, running the exact sparse spectrum learner with oracle $f$ uses zero random examples, makes at most the exact sparse spectrum query budget for $(n,k)$ membership queries, and performs at most the exact sparse spectrum work budget for $(n,k)$ local computation steps.
hypotheses_covered: The target is a Boolean function on the sign cube
